analysis.reasonEn: Compared to the previous reading, RSI rose from 48.5 to 49.4, confirming an exit from the oversold zone. MACD histogram improvement continues. Although the 5-day volume ratio was 0.65 (contracted), the price action of +1.65% 4 days ago, -0.89% yesterday, and +2.41% today signals a return to an uptrend.
